title: tc-relationship-graph
description:
Connections between people and organisations around one of them – direct and second-hand rings, relationships drawn
by strength, re-centring on click, and a panel and keyboard list of the connections.

heading.description: The heading, and the graph's name

nodes.description: People, organisations and anything else, each with a kind

ego.description: The node in the middle (the ego); by default the first person. Changed by the user unless tc-ego-change is prevented

depth.description: How far out to draw: 1 (direct connections) or 2 (theirs too). Changed by the user unless tc-depth-change is prevented

kinds.description: The kinds shown; empty for all. Changed from the legend unless tc-kinds-change is prevented

selected.description: What's selected: a node id, "edge:<edge id>", or null. Changed by the user unless tc-selected-change is prevented

kindLabels.description: Names for the kinds in the legend: { organisation: "Organisation" }
